body.x: Buryeok Energy will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its smart IoT streetlight system specialized for smart cities.

Conventional smart streetlights use sensors to detect the brightness or the movement of objects and adjust the brightness, and a black box-type camera is installed on the streetlights. However, Buryeok Energy's smart IoT streetlight system is different from existing products.

Buryeok Energy analyzes the images recorded on the camera with deep learning technology to detect only those who wear clothes of a specific color, and uses sensors to track the number of vehicles and the maximum speed of each vehicle lane, average vehicle speed, vehicle length, and length of traffic jam.

Collected information is all stored in the server, and based on the information stored in the server, the drivers can find out about the road situation by seeing the traffic on the road signs. As a result, if drivers find their own roads, driving congestion will be eliminated, and this will contribute to forming the active ITS (Intelligent Transport Systems). In addition, Buryeok Energy is planning to develop specialized solutions based on the requirements of cities.

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
